title: Chapter 282 Dragon Breath Vs. Immortal Fire
content:
Chapter 282 Dragon Breath Vs. Immortal Fire

At the same time, the hot breath in Ye Yan's body was also constantly gushing out of his body.

In an instant, everyone in the entire square was sweating profusely.

There is no doubt that at this moment, the movements of the two attracted almost everyone in the academy, whether they were students or tutors, and they all gave up their affairs and rushed towards this place without stopping.

One is the pride of their academy and a powerful man who is well-known to the world.

Yan Emperor Ye Yan.

The other one is the absolute king among the monsters, the nine-clawed extreme dragon.

It is even rare to see in the ages.

The battle between the two will definitely be recorded in history.

For a moment, everyone present was also excited.

"Can Senior Brother Ye win?"

A student in the inner school asked his own questions.

It’s not that he doesn’t believe in Ye Yan’s strength, but that the legend of the Nine-Clawed Dragon is really exaggerated, which makes him hesitate.

Hearing this, someone immediately angrily rebuked: "What's the Nine-Clawed Dragon? Senior Brother Ye is a peerless monster who has been holding on the monster list for hundreds of years. The legend is just a legend. Who knows if someone deliberately made it up. ”

This remark attracted the recognition of some people present.

After all, until Ao Qing appeared, the legend of the Nine-Clawed Dragon was always controversial.

It was once considered that the demon clan members deliberately fabricated it in order to consolidate their status.

Because the nine-clawed dragon has never appeared in the world for so many years, and the eight-clawed dragon is already so powerful. Perhaps the nine-clawed dragon does not exist at all.

Now, Ao Qing appears.

It directly broke everyone's doubts.

However, everyone obviously still maintained a skeptical attitude towards the strength of the Nine-Clawed Dragon.

In the void.

Several tutors from the academy were also watching silently.

Except for Jordan Yang who was not present, the rest of the people came here.

"Do you think Ye Yan can win?"

asked a tutor.

Hearing this, the rest of the people were silent.

Tan Songci shook his head and said, "It's hard to say. The entire fairy world knows nothing about the strength of the Nine-Clawed Dragon. Who is stronger and weaker, you can only know when you fight."

Hearing this, everyone nodded.

really.

You will know who is stronger and who is weaker immediately.

boom!

At this time, a roar suddenly came from the barrier.

At this moment, the barrier has almost been infinitely magnified by the dean of the academy, so when fighting, there is no scruples.

Everyone looked at him and saw Ao Qing hit Ye Yan in the distance, shaking the void and roaring.

Seeing this scene, everyone looked a little solemn.

It is enough to show how powerful Ao Qing's body is.

Ye Yan in the distance obviously discovered this, then pinched his hands and a flame beside him shot directly towards Ao Qing in the distance.

Buzz —

The flame began to grow rapidly during the flight, and in a blink of an eye it had reached the size of half the dragon head of Ao Qing.

Faced with this fierce flame, Ao Qing had a hint of disdain in his eyes, and he did not react at all, and continued to crash towards Ye Yan.

There was a bang.

As the flame hit, a smile suddenly appeared on the faces of the students in the academy.

"I just said, legends are legends after all."

"No, this is the Nine-Clawed Dragon?"

"Wait, look!"

As soon as everyone spoke, they saw Ao Qing's figure flying out of the sea of fire, and it looked unscathed.

"How is this possible?"

Ao Qing took over Ye Yan's first flame!

In the distance, Ye Yan's expression also became solemn. At this moment, Ao Qing was already close.

It's too late to hide.

Wow!

A flame suddenly burned into Ye Yan's right palm again, and there was a blue flame.

Ye Yan clenched his fist violently and then punched him out.

Rumble!

The void vibrated again.

And Ao Qing has arrived nearly a thousand.

The fist flame collided with the body, and with Ye Yan's muffled groan, he spit out a mouthful of turbid learning. Ao Qing obviously won the first match.

"The list of demons? That's it? Boy, I can't even break my body when I come, so I'd give up just now."

Ao Qing's mocking words rang out from the void.

Hearing this, the students from all colleges were immediately angry and wanted to refute, but they didn't know how to speak.

After pondering for a while, everyone could only look at Ye Yan, whose face was a little pale in the distance, and shouted: "Senior Brother Ye, come on!"

"Senior Brother Ye, defeat him! Let him see the strength of my academy!"

In the corner, Xiao Luo, Qin Feng and others looked a little embarrassed.

They almost couldn't help but cheer just now.

If I hadn't held back, I'd probably have been beaten up by a group now.

At this time, Qin Feng's eyes rolled, as if he had thought of something, then he smiled and came to Xu Zijing, "Brother Xu, what do you think?"

Xu Zijing.

The people around also set their sights on Xu Zijing.

Ao Qing had the upper hand just now, and the few people present were more or less emotional. Only Xu Zijing's face was calm, as if this battle had nothing to do with him.

"I?"

Xu Zijing was slightly stunned, then slap the feather fan in his hand, coughed lightly, and said, "Nine-Clawed Dragon, it is worthy of its reputation."

"That's it?"

Qin Feng was obviously a little dissatisfied with this answer.

Upon hearing this, Xu Zijing laughed and said, "Then what else can I say."

At this time, Xiao Luo came over and said with a smile: "Brother Xu, who do you hope to win?"

Suddenly, Xu Zijing's smile froze.

This problem is a bit tricky.

If it were someone else in the academy, he would definitely choose Ye Yan without hesitation.

But he is different. He knows that Ao Qing is not simple.

The background is not simple.

This is forcing him to take the team now.

Xu Zijing was a little silent, but then he suddenly pointed at the void, "Damn it, look!"

Hearing this, everyone hurriedly looked at the void.

I saw a huge earth flame rising from Ye Yan.

What's more important is that at this moment, the flame suddenly changed from blue to blue.

Seeing this scene, everyone felt that the flame seemed to be stronger than before.

Only Li Changqing in the void understood how many times stronger this flame was than the blue flame just now.

"It's worthy of being the Nine-Clawed Dragon, and it can actually force out this kid's green flame."

Li Changqing murmured.

In the void, Ye Yan looked at Ao Qing in the distance without expression.

At the same time, Ye Yan pinched his hands again, and the flames in front of him suddenly changed.

Become extremely aggressive.

"I wonder if you can still take this attack."

"Green flames and long rainbow!"

laugh!

A blue flame slashed through the void and illuminated the entire academy.

Everyone looked at the fire that was like a meteor and shot towards Ao Qing, and their hearts were in their throats.

Faced with this, Ao Qing finally couldn't help but laugh out loud.

"Playing with fire in front of my dragon clan, boy, you're a little tender!"

Ao Qing opened his bloody mouth, and a terrifying dragon breath spurted out from Ao Qing's mouth.

In an instant, the two flames collided together, making a deafening roar.

"What!"

Everyone was shocked by Ao Qing's move.

Ao Qing has been fighting on his body all the time, and for a moment they forgot the Dragon Breath, which the Dragon Clan is best at.

That is one of the most powerful flames in the world.

What's more, this is the dragon breath of the nine-clawed extreme dragon.

That power is definitely to be further improved!
